name: fill_input
description: Type text into an input field, search box, or textarea. Optionally simulates pressing the 'Enter' key immediately after filling to submit forms or search queries in a single step.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input field or textarea (e.g. 'input[type="search"]', '#query-input').

text.description: Text value to type into the field.

press_enter.description: Whether to simulate pressing the Enter key immediately after typing the text. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
